verdict.rationale: Ramp ships an official, hosted MCP server at https://mcp.ramp.com/mcp, plus Developer and Data MCP servers. The docs cover connecting assistants like Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor, admin and role-based access controls, multi-business aliases and a demo endpoint. Independent probes confirm the live endpoints: the production server is OAuth-gated per the MCP authorization spec with granular scopes, and the developer MCP server is reachable without authentication.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Ramp MCP allows you to securely connect Ramp with AI assistants like ChatGPT and Claude, so you can query Ramp data and take actions with natural language.
